title: Signed binomial coefficient formula
statement: For all nonnegative integers $n,z,j$, the coefficient of $X^j$ in $(1-X)^z(1+X)^{n-z}$ over $\mathbb R$ is $\sum_{k=0}^{j}(-1)^k\binom{z}{k}\binom{n-z}{j-k}$.
